## Checklist

- [ ] `claude plugin validate .` and `claude plugin test .` pass.
- [ ] `bash scripts/scan.sh` passes.
- [ ] A new rule has a test, and I checked that the test fails when the code is wrong.
- [ ] I added a line under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] The tests and examples use made-up data. Nothing comes from a real session.
- [ ] I added no network access and no file access.
- [ ] I did not rename the command, a setting or the plugin name. (If I did, I explain why above.)
